name: Commerce Novaposhta
description: Provides Nova Poshta (Ukrainian carrier) integration with Commerce Shipping, including a warehouse/city selection field and API-based shipping rate calculation.
project_description:
Overview 

 Integration of the Novaposhta API 2.0 with Commerce Shipping. Provides estimated shipping costs and warehouses selection of Novaposhta services. This module should be used by those that want to provide Novaposhta shipping to their customers.

 Requirements 

 
 This module requires Novaposhta account and API Key 
 Commerce Shipping module 
 
 Installation and configuration 

 
 Install and enable the module and all dependencies. 
 Add dimensions and weight fields (new field types via the Physical module) to all shippable product types. 
 Populate dimensions and weight fields for all products. 
 Configure Novaposhta settings in Administration » Configuration » Web services » Commerce Novaposhta (/admin/config/services/commerce-novaposhta). 
 Add Novaposhta shipping method (/admin/commerce/shipping-methods). 
 Enable Novaposhta address field for user profile (/admin/config/people/profile-types/manage/PROFILE_TYPE) -> Profiles of this type includes Novaposhta address
